scenes.narration: Mistype a command and ModernTex flags it as you write.
The PDF updates, and every citation resolves.
Need a figure? Draw it in the TikZ designer. Drop boxes and decisions on the canvas, connect them, and the TikZ code is written for you.
Insert it at the cursor, and the figure appears in the live preview.
Tables work the same way. Add rows and columns, type in your results, and get clean booktabs LaTeX to insert.
Can't remember a command? Search the symbol palette for Greek letters, operators and arrows, with the LaTeX shown under each.
The sidebar keeps your outline, your bibliography entries, and your revision history at hand.
Then check the whole paper against submission rules before you send it.
One purchase. Nineteen ninety-nine, updates included.
